svg.title: A-300 Typical Apartment — Enlarged Plan
svg.text: External / party wall cut by section, 300 mm —
Single leaf door, swing shown to opening side
Glazed opening — arched head where noted
Element above the cut plane (pergola, slab
1. Enlarged from A-101; the second floor is identical. Only
the entry, wet rooms and kitchenettes are shown at this
scale — a whole 13.90 m unit does not fit an A1 sheet at
2. Apartment A: bathroom and entry hall side by side on the
front door, so the bathroom is reached from the hall and
from the bedroom without crossing the living room.
Kitchenette runs against the party wall in the south-east
3. Apartment B: bathroom off its own entry hall with a window
in the open east wall, kitchenette against the party wall
4. All kitchenettes are one joinery run: 600 mm sink bay,
two-ring induction hob, undercounter fridge and overhead
storage over the full length. Recirculating hood unless a
duct to the riser is confirmed.
5. Every wet room drains to the riser cupboard on the party
wall; runs longer than 2 m fall at 1:40 within the 300 mm
Withdrawn at P22 — superseded by A-100 to A-104. Record only; not for construction, pricing or measurement.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
P19 2026-10-07 serpentine waist deepened 0.75 to 1.35 m; 15.7 m² of balcony a floor
P20 2026-10-07 internal partitions 100 mm red brick, specified by the client
P21 2026-10-07 300 mm external and party walls: brick, colour unrestricted
P22 2026-10-08 A-300 to A-302 withdrawn: enlargements of a building not being built
